tm.「{var:1}ちゃん ごめんなさいね。\n 海図を さんざん調べたけれど\n: "Sorry, {var:1}. I searched the sea charts thoroughly, but this place isn't written anywhere.
tm.「こういう ワケのわからない場所は\n 早く オサラバしたいけれど\n 船が乗り: "I'd like to get out of a bizarre place like this quickly, but the ship ran aground and can't sail.
tm.「不思議な場所に 迷い込んじまったな。\n 風も吹かなけりゃ 波ひとつ立たない海: "We wandered into a strange place. A sea with no wind and not a single wave. What on earth happened...
tm.「キレイな場所ですわね……。\n 子供の頃 読んだ おとぎ話の絵本に\n こんな: "What a beautiful place... A picture book fairy tale I read as a child showed scenery like this.
tm.「私も いつか こんな場所に\n 絵本の中の王子さまと 来てみたいって\n お姉: "Sister and I often talked about visiting a place like this someday with a prince from the picture book.
tm.「まったく な～んにもないとこねぇ。\n {var:1} こんな所に 長居は無用: "Honestly, there's absolutely nothing here. {var:1}, no point lingering. Let's go find the orb already.
tm.「うぅむ。興味深い……。\n この船の骨格 船首の構造……。\n わしの生まれる: "Hmm. Fascinating... This ship's frame and bow structure. It's from long, long before I was born.
tm.「もしや ここが ウワサに聞く\n 神隠しの海域かのう……。\n この場所だけ: "Could this be the sea area of rumor, where people vanish by divine will...? Time seems to have stopped only here.
tm.しかし 何も反応がない。\n迎えの人魚は 現れないようだ。: But nothing responded. It seems no mermaid will come to fetch you.
tm.「おやあ ダンナ…… すまねえでげす。\n なんだか 急に 船の調子が悪くなって: "Oh, boss... sorry. The ship's condition suddenly turned bad and it can't sail right now.
tm.「それはそうと {var:1}のダンナ。\n 勇者ゆかりの地の ドゥーランダ山へ: "By the way, boss {var:1}, don't you need to go to Mount Pang Lai, the Luminary's holy site?
tm.「たしか ドゥーランダ山へ行くには\n ここから北へ進んだ先の 山門を通るでがす: "To reach Mount Pang Lai, you go through the mountain gate north of here. I'll fix the ship by the time you're back!
tm.「シルビアねえさんの船は\n あっしが カンペキに準備しといたでがす！\n どん: "I've prepared Sylvando's ship perfectly! It won't lose to any rough waves!
tm.「さあ {var:1}のダンナ！\n シルビアねえさんの船に乗って\n 仲間探し: "Come on, boss {var:1}! Board Sylvando's ship and set out on the journey to find your companions!
tm.「おーい 旅の方！\n この辺りの海は 危険だ！\n 気をつけて 進むんだぞー！: "Hey, traveler! The waters around here are dangerous! Sail carefully!
tm.マーメイドハープが\nひとりでに 鳴りはじめた！: The Mermaid harp began to sound on its own!
tm.デスエーギルを倒した！\n海底王国の宮殿にいる\n女王セレンに 報告しよう。: You defeated Death Aegir! Report to Queen Seren in the palace of the undersea kingdom.
tm.黄金にかがやく 氷山が浮いている。\nどうやら この先は 通れなさそうだ。: A golden glowing iceberg floats here. It seems you can't pass beyond.
tm.この先 キケン！\nキラーパンサーに 注意！: Danger ahead! Beware the killer panthers!
tm.「どうした {var:1}よ。\n 今は カミュを助けだすのが 最優先じゃ。\n: "What's wrong, {var:1}? Right now, rescuing Erik is the top priority. This is no time to go elsewhere.
tm.「神父殿が言うには バイキングのアジトは\n クレイモラン城下町から 船で出て\: "The priest said the Viking hideout is in a cave very near, by ship from Sniflheim's castle town.
tm.「{var:1} すまねえが\n 旅立ちのほこらへ 向かう前に\n オレの目的を: "{var:1}, sorry, but before we go to the Door of Departure, let me fulfill my aim.
tm.「デルカダール神殿に 移されたはずの\n レッドオーブを 取りにいくぞ。: "Let's go get the Red orb that should have been moved to Kingsbarrow.
tm.ソルッチャ運河\n東に抜けると 内海: Soltchia Canal. Exiting east leads to the inner sea.
tm.水門が 閉じている。\nこの先には 進めないようだ。: The floodgate is closed. It seems you can't proceed.
tm.水中から 光の柱が のびている。\nしかし 今は 何も起きないようだ。: A pillar of light extends from underwater. But nothing seems to happen now.
tm.ここより東 グロッタの町\n南へ行くと ユグノア城跡: East: Octagonia. South: the Dundrasil Castle ruins.
tm.ここより北 グロッタの町\n南へ行くと ユグノア城跡: North: Octagonia. South: the Dundrasil Castle ruins.
